os_type.title: os_type
os_type.info:
Operating system type.

0 = Windows

1 = macOS (pre v7.70)

2 = Linux (pre v7.70)

On v7.71+, 0 is returned for all platforms unless the theme specifies `want_os_type 1` in rtconfig.txt. In that case, macOS = 3 and Linux = 4.

v7.70 always reports 3 for macOS and 4 for Linux.

folderstate.title: folderstate
folderstate.info:
Folder state of track, if applicable.

0 = normal

-n = last track in folder(s).

folderdepth.title: folderdepth
folderdepth.info: Positive if in a folder. Indicates how many folders deep.

maxfolderdepth.title: maxfolderdepth
maxfolderdepth.info: Highest folder depth of any track.

mcp_maxfolderdepth.title: mcp_maxfolderdepth
mcp_maxfolderdepth.info: Highest folder depth of any track in the mixer.

recarm.title: recarm
recarm.info: Nonzero if track is record armed.

tcp_iconsize.title: tcp_iconsize
tcp_iconsize.info: Size of track panel icon column, if any.

mcp_iconsize.title: mcp_iconsize
mcp_iconsize.info: Size of mixer icon row, if any.

mcp_wantextmix.title: mcp_wantextmix
mcp_wantextmix.info:
Flags indicating which extended mixer settings are desired.

&1 = inserts

&2 = sends

&4 = FX parameters.

trackpanmode.title: trackpanmode
trackpanmode.info:
Pan mode of track.

0 = classic 3.x

3 = new balance

5 = stereo pan

6 = dual pan.

tcp_fxparms.title: tcp_fxparms
tcp_fxparms.info: Count of TCP FX parameters visible (0-n), including sends or FX items if visible.

tcp_fxembed.title: tcp_fxembed
tcp_fxembed.info: Count of TCP embedded FX visible.

mcp_fxembed.title: mcp_fxembed
mcp_fxembed.info: Count of MCP embedded FX visible.

tcp_sends_enabled.title: tcp_sends_enabled
tcp_sends_enabled.info: User preference to show sends in TCP is enabled.

tcp_fxlist_enabled.title: tcp_fxlist_enabled
tcp_fxlist_enabled.info: User preference to show FX inserts in TCP is enabled.

trackpinned.title: trackpinned
trackpinned.info:
TCP-pinned state.

1 = pinned, but globally disabled

2 = pinned.

tcp_hidden_overridden.title: tcp_hidden_overridden
tcp_hidden_overridden.info: 1 if track is marked hidden in TCP but being displayed due to global override.

trackcolor_valid.title: trackcolor_valid
trackcolor_valid.info: Set to 1 if track color is set.

trackcolor_r.title: trackcolor_r
trackcolor_r.info:
Valid if `trackcolor_valid` is set.

Red value, 0-255.

trackcolor_g.title: trackcolor_g
trackcolor_g.info:
Valid if `trackcolor_valid` is set.

Green value, 0-255.

trackcolor_b.title: trackcolor_b
trackcolor_b.info:
Valid if `trackcolor_valid` is set.

Blue value, 0-255.

mixer_visible.title: mixer_visible
mixer_visible.info: Set to 1 if the mixer is visible.

track_selected.title: track_selected
track_selected.info: Set to 1 if track is selected.

ntracks.title: ntracks
ntracks.info: Total track count, not including master.

trans_flags.title: trans_flags
trans_flags.info:
Transport display flags.

`trans_flags&1` is nonzero if transport is centered.

`trans_flags&2` is nonzero if user wants play speed controls visible.

`trans_flags&4` is nonzero if user wants current time signature visible.

envcp_type.title: envcp_type
envcp_type.info: 4 if FX envelope, which can display additional controls.

env_selected.title: env_selected
env_selected.info: Set to 1 if envelope is selected.

clear: Clears a particular attribute (or wildcard list of attributes) to empty
reset: Resets a particular attribute (or wildcard list of attributes) to their default settings
set: Sets an attribute or user variable to an expression. Note that you do not need to declare use variables, simply setting them is sufficient. As a matter of etiquette, do not use `.` in user variables (although you can), names with `.` in them are reserved for future expansion.
def: Defines a value to be replaced with another value (e.g. a preprocessor #define).
front: Brings an element to the front of the Z order. Note that the ordering of elements is static and can't be affected by logic.
macro: (REAPER 5.0+) Defines a macro with any number of parameters which can be used later. Note that using ## in a macro allows the parameter to be concatenated with another named string.
define_parameter: (REAPER 6.0+) Defines a ReaScript-accessible user-defined parameter which the WALTER code can use. The default theme adjuster script will allow tweaking the first 10 parameters.
custom: (REAPER 7.0+) Defines a custom element. Note that the custom element name must include the string 'custom.' Custom elements become a normal part of the layout that contains them and can be used with set, front, etc. If command_id is specified and valid, and button_image is a valid image name, element will be a button. Otherwise, it will be a static text element with 'text_label.' tcp.custom.xyz.font .color and .margin may all be specified.
version: uses newer v5 theme composition mode, recommended for new themesc (also enables PNG support) (REAPER 5.0+)
tcp_heights: default height of tcp panels, super-collapsed, small, medium, and full heights
tcp_voltext_flags: flag for volume strings: set 1 for no-dB, 2 for no-fractional-precision, 4 for no + on positive values, 8 for always show two digits of precision. maxlen specifies max length of total string
tcp_master_voltext_flags: flag for volume strings: set 1 for no-dB, 2 for no-fractional-precision, 4 for no + on positive values, 8 for always show two digits of precision. maxlen specifies max length of total string
mcp_voltext_flags: flag for volume strings: set 1 for no-dB, 2 for no-fractional-precision, 4 for no + on positive values, 8 for always show two digits of precision. maxlen specifies max length of total string
mcp_master_voltext_flags: flag for volume strings: set 1 for no-dB, 2 for no-fractional-precision, 4 for no + on positive values, 8 for always show two digits of precision. maxlen specifies max length of total string
tcp_vupeakwidth: size (in px) of the peak hold indicator for track panel meter
mcp_vupeakheight: size (in px) of the peak hold indicator for mixer meter
mcp_mastervupeakheight: size (in px) of the peak hold indicator for the mixer master meter
tcp_showborders: set to 0 to disable borders in the track panels (deprecated)
mcp_showborders: set to 0 to disable borders in the mixer (deprecated)

mcp_altmeterpos: put MCP meters on right side (deprecated)
tcp_vol_zeroline: sets the ABGR value of the tcp's volume fader zero line. FFFF0000 would be solid blue, for example (v2.0+) -- note that this used to be documented incorrectly.
tcp_pan_zeroline: tcp pan fader zero line color (v2.0+)

mcp_vol_zeroline: mcp vol fader zero line color (v2.0+)

no_meter_reclbl: don't show tcp meter record-input label
gen_pan_zeroline: general pan fader zero line color
gen_vol_zeroline: general vol fader zero line color
warnings: all/pedantic. note that this is only used if the theme is not zipped
misc_dpi_translate: affects elements such as toolbar images: theme can specify one or more of these lines -- if the DPI scaling is higher than src_scale_percent, dest_scale_percent is used. so for example 'misc_dpi_translate 126 150' would ensure that the 1.5x images are used when the DPI is above 126%.
global_scale: can specify the inherent DPI-scaling of the theme -- e.g. if the theme is all hidpi images, setting this to 2.0 would prevent a 2x display from scaling those images up further.
layout_dpi_translate: remapping of layouts by DPI. if DPI is > min_scale (where 1.0 = 100%, 1.5=150%, etc), then if requested_layout_name is chosen by user, destination_layout_name will be used instead. Note that you can use an empty requested_layout_name to match the default layout.
